name: Eitan 8x8 APC
armament: IFV: 30 mm turret with Spike missiles (in development)
protection: NERA composite armour, high mine-resistant floor, run-flat tyres, Iron Fist APS planned. Sources disagree on weight (about 35 t, up to 50 t listed). Game rule: immune to small-calibre; 7.62x54R AP and 12.7/14.5 mm can disable tyres, optics and an exposed gunner; launchers penetrate.
visual_notes: Tall, boxy 8x8 hull with 4 axles (gap between 2nd and 3rd), steep glacis and driver on the left
Samson RCWS on the roof; rear ramp
Big flat armoured side panels with stowage boxes; anti-drone mesh in Gaza use
